_readme: 'Use it today' micro-challenges (under 5 minutes). Lessons add their own challenges in 'useToday'; these generic templates fill in today's content. Placeholders: {w1} {w2} {w3} today's words, {phrase} a phrase of the day, {term} a system term, {ripple} today's error, {symptom} where it shows up, {stage} the stage, {topic} the lesson, {grammar} today's grammar topic, {kpi} a KPI. The app never repeats a challenge within 21 days and never uses the same type two days in a row.

templates.text: Write your next Teams message in German and use 3 of today's words: {w1}, {w2}, {w3}.
Write a two-line note to yourself in German about today's topic. Use „{w1}“.
Reply to one colleague in German today, even if they wrote in English. Two sentences are enough.
Use the phrase „{phrase}“ in a conversation or call today.
In your next phone call or meeting, say one full German sentence with „{w2}“.
Say a date and an insured number aloud in German, as if you were on the phone with an insurer. Twice, slowly.
Ask a colleague a real work question in German that starts with „Weisst du, ob …?“
Ask a colleague how they would explain „{w3}“ in simple German. Note their words.
In your next meeting, write down 3 German words you hear but don't use yet.
Read one German work email slowly and find 2 words from this week's topics.
Use today's grammar ({grammar}) once in a real message at work.
Put a sticky note with „{w1}“ on your screen and use the word once before you leave.
Explain „{term}“ to a colleague in two sentences.
Explain today's ripple effect to a colleague: „{ripple}“ leads to „{symptom}“.
Spot one rejection or insurer query in today's worklist and trace it back: at which stage was the error made?
Pick one open case on your list and ask: could today's error be behind it? ({ripple})
In SAP GUI, press F1 → Technical information on one field you used today. Note the table and field.
Watch one real step of '{stage}' today (a booking, an order, an admission). Who does what, and where could data go wrong?
Note one small improvement idea for '{topic}' in one sentence: problem → idea → benefit.
Estimate „{kpi}“ for your team. A rough guess is fine – then check who could measure it.
Ask someone from another team (billing, clinic or IT) what bothers them most about '{stage}'. One question, two minutes.
Find one case today where data from an earlier step was wrong or missing. Which stage caused it?
